latest.headline: StoryVS_TTV Returns to Dominant Form in Greece
latest.paragraph: StoryVS_TTV demonstrated his absolute mastery of the gravel in Greece, delivering a perfect performance by winning every single one of the six scheduled stages. He completed the rally in 49 minutes 20.369 seconds, comfortably outpacing his rivals to secure a maximum points haul of 30. GTI_1990 maintained his season-long consistency by claiming second place, while Simonayy66 rounded out the podium. The demanding Greek stages proved difficult for several competitors, with five drivers, including SWAD42 and stjuudents, failing to finish the full rally distance after suffering stage-related incidents.
